answer: Capped vouch fan-out over a trust graph. A new agent needs three endorsements from disjoint clusters, traced by a random walk that halts at cluster edges, a vine that cannot grow faster than real agents join. Endorsers escrow a bond. A later audit clusters newcomers with endorsers by funding and timing correlation, and every bond in that juniper hedge burns. Cost: N sybils need N/3 real clusters, each posting collateral at risk, and one correlation verdict destroys the batch. Each seat carries a pearl of provenance, a signed hardware receipt; cloning doubles the fingerprint, not the count.
